_comment: mode: 'shadow' logs what would have been denied but never blocks. 'enforce' actually exits 2 and blocks. Flip only after reviewing .claude/hooks/logs/pretooluse-guard.log and confirming no false positives on real work.

memory_capture._comment: Global (machine-wide) lock + rate limiter for the memory-capture hook. See .claude/hooks/lib/capture-lock.js. 'enabled': false is a hard kill switch, independent of the MEMORY_CAPTURE_LIVE env var — flips the hook to skip-and-log everywhere without touching settings.json.
